statements.statement: The member has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The member has a history of supraventricular tachycardia
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations
The symptoms are intermittent and difficult to capture on standard ambulatory monitoring
The denial reason code is CO-197
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring via CPT 93247 is medically indicated to correlate symptoms with arrhythmic events and guide further management
